system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:41:49 UTC, the domain controller logged creation of it_helper, with omar.haddad as the subject.
Seven seconds later, the domain controller logged it_helper being added to the Administrators group by omar.haddad under the same logon ID.

The account name is not in the documented tmp.<name> format for temporary accounts, and its addition to Administrators conflicts with the documented practice that temporary accounts receive no administrator rights.

The records identify the account-management subject but do not identify the workstation or source address used for the changes; the available records therefore do not establish whether the activity came from the approved remote-administration workstation.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied collection-status information reports a winsec and sysmon collection outage on WS-BCARTER-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC. This overlaps the account creation and membership change, limiting endpoint attribution during that interval.
The provided domain-controller account-management records show the subject account and logon ID but do not include a source workstation or source address.
claims_not_established: Whether creating and granting administrator membership to it_helper was an authorized, approved change.
Whether omar.haddad personally performed the actions or the account or session was compromised.
Which workstation or address originated the account-management actions.
Whether it_helper was subsequently used, remains enabled, or retains administrator membership.
additional_evidence_needed: Verify the change against an approved ticket or confirmation from the responsible administrator.
Collect domain-controller authentication and session records for logon ID 0xc5db44d, including source workstation and address, and correlate them with WS-OHADDAD-01 telemetry.
Review the account's current state, group memberships, and authentication or activity history after creation.
Recover or obtain any available endpoint telemetry for WS-BCARTER-01 during the collection outage and correlate it with the domain-controller events.
